name: flexyBayesOrchestra: Constellation Glue for 'flexyBayes': Surrogates, Ensembles and Derived Priors
description: Companion to the 'flexyBayes' Bayesian mixed-model engine that supplies the orchestra-composition layer: cheap surrogate emulators of expensive fits, ensemble-source ingestion and verification, ensemble-derived priors, posterior predictive checks for surrogates, and dormant cross-engine backend slots. Depends on 'flexyBayes' for the core model representation and emits results in the same shapes.
